title: Integral tower realization with the fixed explicit counit
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Write $\mathcal C_T(\Lambda)=\Dctf(T,\Lambda)$ for the bounded constructible finite-Tor pro-etale condensed-module category [sk-def-sfb-constructible], $F_{f,\Lambda}=Rf_{!,\Lambda}$, $G_{f,\Lambda}=f^!_\Lambda$ with its specified restricted adjunction $F_{f,\Lambda}\dashv G_{f,\Lambda}$ and counit $\varepsilon_{f,\Lambda}$ [sk-thm-existence], and $J_{f,\Lambda}=f^*_\Lambda(-)(d)[2d]$ with the Tate twists of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed].

For every finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\Qlb$, use the completed coefficient sheaf $R_{E,T}=\varprojlim_n(\mathcal O_E/\ell^n)_T$, derived-complete integral constructible category and comparison with condensed integral modules [sk-lem-integral-models]. Put $r_TK=(K\otimes^L_{R_{E,T}}(\mathcal O_E/\ell^n)_T)_n$, with normalized towers and $L_T=R\varprojlim$ as in [det-sp-normalized-equivalence]. Let $H_{f,E}=L_Xf^!_\bullet r_Y$ with counit $\varepsilon^H$, and $\gamma^H=L_X\gamma_{f,\bullet}r_Y:J_{f,\mathcal O_E}\xrightarrow{\sim}H_{f,E}$, using the actual tower morphism and realized adjunction of [det-sp-tower-gamma, det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection]. Identify the left adjoint with the ambient compactification composite $R\bar f_*j_!$ by [det-sp-integral-direct-image-tower]. Let $\delta_E:H_{f,E}\xrightarrow{\sim}G_{f,\mathcal O_E}$ be the counit-preserving comparison [det-sp-unique-right-adjoint], and put $\gamma^T_E=\delta_E\gamma^H$.

Then the tower Hom adjunction, transported by $r_T\dashv L_T$ and postcomposition with $(\gamma^H)^{-1}$, defines an adjunction $F_{f,\mathcal O_E}\dashv J_{f,\mathcal O_E}$ on the condensed categories with counit
$$t^E_K=\varepsilon^H_K\circ F_{f,\mathcal O_E}(\gamma^H_K)=\varepsilon_{f,\mathcal O_E,K}\circ F_{f,\mathcal O_E}(\gamma^T_{E,K}).$$
Its reductions are exactly the finite adjunctions and counits. The actual map $\gamma^T_E$ equals the coherent trace-transpose family of [lem-pur-tower-trace-purity-comparison]; its trace, composition and Cartesian base-change equations are those reconstructed simultaneously in [prop-pur-adic-reconstruction-trace-coherence]. For every finite $E\subset F$, completed scalar extension $-\otimes^L_{R_{E,T}}R_{F,T}$ carries these actual adjunctions, units, counits and maps to their $F$ counterparts by the tower comparisons of [det-sp-field-extension-towers], transitively for $E\subset F\subset L$. These assertions include uniformizer reductions via the canonical cofinal comparison with the $\ell$-power tower. On affine charts the counit is the realization of fibre sum followed by iterated projective-line integration, with the precise local tower counits of [det-sp-tower-gluing].
